description_en: Queries the details of an AccessKey pair leak event
name: DescribeAccessKeyLeakDetail

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AccessKey pair leak event to query.

Call the [DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询AK泄露事件的ID。

调用[DescribeAccesskeyLeakList](~~DescribeAccesskeyLeakList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Asset.description_en: The platform where the asset resides. The value is fixed as Cloud Platform
Asset.description_zh: 资产所在的平台，取值固定为云平台

DealTime.description_en: The time when the AccessKey pair leak event was handled

DealType.description_en:
The method used to handle the AccessKey pair leak event. Valid values:

manual: manually deleted
disable: manually disabled
add-whitelist: added to the whitelist
pending: not handled
DealType.description_zh:
AK泄露事件的处理方式。取值：

manual：已确认手动删除
disable：已手动禁用
add-whitelist：已加白名单
pending：未处理

GithubFileType.description_en:
The GitHub file type. Valid values:

Python
XML
GO
Javascript
INI
JSON
C++
GithubFileType.description_zh:
GitHub文件类型。取值：

Python
XML
GO
Javascript
INI
JSON
C++

GithubFileUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the GitHub file was last updated

GithubFileUrl.description_en: The URL of the GitHub file

GithubRepoUrl.description_en: The URL of the GitHub repository

GithubUserPicUrl.description_en: The profile picture URL of the GitHub user

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the AccessKey pair leak event was first detected
GmtCreate.description_zh: AK泄露事件的首次发现时间

GmtModified.description_en: The most recent time when the leak event was detected
GmtModified.description_zh: 泄露事件的最新发现时间

Remark.description_en: The remarks of the AccessKey pair leak event

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Source.description_en: The intelligence source of the AccessKey pair leak event

TokenValid.description_en:
The validity of the key associated with the AccessKey pair. Valid values:

0: to be confirmed
1: valid
2: invalid
TokenValid.description_zh:
AK关联的密钥有效性。取值：

0：待确认
1：有效
2：无效

Type.description_en: The type of the leaked information. The value is fixed as AccessKey
Type.description_zh: 泄露信息的类型，固定取值为AccessKey

WhitelistStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the AccessKey pair leak event is added to the whitelist. Valid values:

no: not added to the whitelist
yes: added to the whitelist
WhitelistStatus.description_zh:
AK泄露事件是否已加入白名单。取值：

no：未加入白名单
yes：已加入白名单

WhitelistTime.description_en: The time when the AccessKey pair was added to the whitelist. Unit: milliseconds
WhitelistTime.description_zh: AK白名单添加时间。单位：毫秒
